title: The 8 Best Wood Filler 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for wood filler 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at wood filler 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Minwax High-Performance Wood Filler, 6-Ounce
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-part epoxy formula, Sandable and stainable, Fast cure.
strengths: Two-part epoxy formula is stronger and more durable than single-part fillers for structural gaps
Accepts stain evenly, matching surrounding wood better than most fillers
Fast cure time allows sanding and finishing the same day
Works on both interior furniture repairs and exterior trim
limitations: Two-part mixing is less convenient than ready-to-use fillers
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Elmer's Carpenter's Wood Filler, 1/2-Pint
products.blurb: Key specs: Ready to use, Sandable, Paintable.
strengths: Very low price for common nail hole and small gap repairs
Ready to use straight from the container with no mixing
Low odor formula suitable for indoor use
limitations: Shrinks noticeably on deeper fills, often needing a second application
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Bondo Wood Filler, 1.9 lbs. with Hardener
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-part formula, Rock hard cure, Sandable and shapeable.
strengths: Cures rock hard, ideal for rotted or structurally compromised wood repairs
Weatherproof once cured, correct for exterior trim and sills
Can be shaped and carved before full cure to match molding profiles
limitations: Strong odor during application and cure
Overkill and more expensive than needed for small cosmetic fills

products.name: FamoWood Latex Wood Filler, Pint, Natural
products.blurb: Key specs: Latex formula, Multiple wood tone shades, Water cleanup.
strengths: Multiple pre-tinted shades reduce the need for stain matching after filling
Water cleanup is far more convenient than solvent-based fillers
Reliable sanding characteristics without gumming up sandpaper
limitations: Less durable than epoxy fillers for load-bearing repairs
Color match is close but rarely exact on stained wood

products.name: System Three SculpWood Putty Epoxy Wood Filler, 8 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: Epoxy putty, Hand moldable, No shrinkage.
strengths: Zero shrinkage on cure, unlike latex or solvent fillers on deep fills
Hand moldable consistency makes it ideal for carved or shaped repairs
Machinable and drillable once fully cured, holds screws and hardware
limitations: Highest price per volume of any filler
Limited working time once the two parts are combined

products.name: Minwax Stainable Wood Filler, 6 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: Absorbs stain like wood, Ready to use, Low odor.
strengths: Absorbs stain much closer to natural wood than most standard fillers
Ready to use, no mixing required for quick repairs
Sands flush without leaving a raised or sunken patch
limitations: Still visible under dark stains on light-colored wood species
Not intended for exterior or high-moisture applications

products.name: PC Products PC-Woody Wood Repair Epoxy Paste, 12 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 2-part epoxy paste, Weatherproof, Sandable and machinable.
strengths: The professional standard for restoring rotted exterior trim, sills, and columns
Fully weatherproof and UV stable once cured and painted
Bonds permanently to sound wood surrounding a repair
limitations: Expensive relative to smaller cosmetic-repair fillers
Requires careful equal-part mixing for full structural strength

products.name: DAP Plastic Wood Filler, 16-Ounce, Natural
products.blurb: Key specs: Solvent-based formula, Sets fast, Sandable and paintable.
strengths: Sets fast enough to sand within 15 to 30 minutes for quick repairs
Long track record as a reliable, widely available general-purpose filler
Inexpensive and sold at nearly every hardware store
limitations: Solvent odor is stronger than water-based alternatives
Shrinks more than epoxy fillers on deeper repairs

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
